content.name: Gemma Hollingworth
content.title: Senior Administrator and Office Manager
content.summary: Senior administrator with 14 years' experience, starting as a business administration apprentice and now running the office for a 60-person architecture practice. Leads a team of three, manages a £180,000 facilities budget and introduced the practice's first digital booking and visitor system.

experience.title: Business Administration Apprentice
bullets: Logged maintenance requests from around 300 tenants and chased contractors until jobs were signed off.
Drafted tenancy renewal letters from templates and posted them on schedule, so no renewal deadline was missed in two years.
Completed a Level 3 Business Administration apprenticeship alongside the role, passing all units first time.

experience.title: Team Administrator
bullets: Supported a repairs team of 12 surveyors, booking appointments and updating the housing management system for 1,100 homes.
Took and circulated minutes for monthly resident panel meetings, with actions published within two working days.
Redesigned the void-property checklist with the lettings manager, shaving four days off the average re-let time.
Processed purchase orders and matched invoices for the repairs budget, flagging duplicate supplier billing worth £6,200.

experience.title: Senior Administrator
bullets: Supervised two legal secretaries and a receptionist, setting rotas so the front desk was covered from 8am to 6pm.
Ran the move from paper files to a case management system for 2,400 live matters with no lost documents.
Coordinated diaries for six partners and arranged court bundles to deadline, often at 24 hours' notice.
Wrote the firm's GDPR-compliant retention schedule with the compliance partner and supervised the secure destruction of 140 archive boxes.

experience.title: Office Manager and Senior Administrative Assistant
bullets: Lead a team of three administrators supporting 60 staff across two studios, handling HR paperwork, post, IT tickets and facilities.
Manage the £180,000 annual facilities budget and finished last year £14,000 under plan after retendering cleaning and waste contracts.
Introduced a desk and meeting-room booking tool and a digital visitor log, which cut room clashes to almost none.
Act as personal assistant to the managing director, organising board papers, client hospitality and quarterly all-staff days.
Act as the office's fire marshal and first aider, keeping risk assessments and the H&S folder ready for audit.

education.degree: A-levels: English Language (B), Business Studies (B), Sociology (C)

courses.name: ILM Level 5 Certificate in Leadership and Management

achievements.title: Office relocation
achievements.detail: Planned the practice's move to a new studio over one weekend, with all 60 desks working on Monday.

achievements.title: Apprentice mentor
achievements.detail: Have mentored three business administration apprentices, two of whom were kept on full-time.

interests: Volunteering at a local food bank
